Option A: Large and positive g shifts are observed when the LUMO – HOMO gap is small and λ is positive.
Option B: Large deviations in g occurs when the energy difference between the SOMO and lowest lying excited state is large.
Option C: A large deviation of g from ge is expected when λ is large and the energy difference between the SOMO and the lowest lying excited state is small.
Option D: A small deviation of g from ge is expected when λ is small and positive.
